newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian woman abducted, gang raped for four days.
newsitem.headline: Belgian woman abducted, gang raped for four days.

text.p: A Belgian woman who was abducted by six men and gang raped over four days finally managed to escape and reach the police as the men were preparing to kill her, Belgian radio and television reported on Wednesday.
The six men are now in prison, charged with collective rape, illegal imprisonment and attempted murder.

Thierry Marchandise, public prosecutor in the central Belgian city of Charleroi, said police were now investigating whether the six men had been involved in other disappearances in the region in recent years.
"It is a hypothesis we are following, because there a certain number of cases that have still not been solved in the Charleroi region," he said.
"We are looking to see if there is a link between this and others," he added.
